item.jaymospowers.bane_weapon.gravesworn: A grave-knight's long blade, cold to the touch
item.jaymospowers.bane_weapon.grudge.des: An outlaw warlord's axe, notched for every name it took
item.jaymospowers.bane_weapon.hornscythe: A demon-sworn's scythe of black horn, warm still
tooltip.jaymospowers.bane_weapon.element: Steeped in %s: now and then a blow bursts with it
jei.jaymospowers.bane_head.gravesworn_bl: Taken from a grave-knight Bane when you end it with its own marks. It can't be cast or forged: put it together at the Tool Station with a Crossguard and a Tough Handle. Its element goes into the weapon.
jei.jaymospowers.bane_head.grudge_head: Taken from an outlaw warlord Bane when you end it with its own marks. It can't be cast or forged: put it together at the Tool Station with a Tough Handle and a Tool Binding. Its element goes into the weapon.
jei.jaymospowers.bane_head.hornscythe_bl: Taken from a demon-sworn Bane when you end it with its own marks. It can't be cast or forged: put it together at the Tool Station with a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding. Its element goes into the weapon.
